entry.name: select
entry.digest: Output bangs based on input matching
entry.description: Selectively outputs a bang in response to any input which matches its arguments and will output non-matching messages out its right-most outlet.

arguments.name: selectors
arguments.description: The arguments can be a mix of ints, floats, or symbols. The number of arguments determines the number of outlets in addition to the rightmost outlet. If there is no argument, there is only one other outlet, which is assigned the integer number.

arguments.name: inlet
arguments.description: If there is a single int argument (or if there are no arguments) a second inlet is created on the right. Numbers received in that inlet are stored in place of the argument. If there is more than one argument, or if the only argument is not an, the right inlet is not created.

attributes.name: fuzzy
attributes.digest: Fuzzy floating-point comparison epsilon
attributes.description: Whenis set to 1, theattribute allows for fuzzy floating-point comparison. This can be useful when sending a float tovia aobject, or other similar objects, where a long floating point number is sent. For example, if the number 0.49999999 is sent towith an argument of 0.5, turningon and settingto 0.01 will cause the two floats to register as a match.
